about: Self-hosting slice 2a (gHashTag/trios#1867): the parity fixture of tests/api/hosting-feed.test.ts.
A closed subset of t27 specs/ (every `use` closure inside it) at two master commits the t27b lab ran:
cf42584c9 (the pin: toolchain.t27 T27_COMMIT) and 8e2e44b7e (the lab run before it).
paths and ids: each subset spec and each feed.t27 *_SOURCES path, and its real git object id at that commit (two lists, so no path sits beside an id).
blobs: each spec blob reduced to its `use` lines (all the closure reads; a job pins these bytes in the fake).
lab: the t27b lab rows of those specs, verbatim from t27b-lab-production /runs/<sha>.json.
hosts: normalized host outputs at cf42584c9, per spec and half (0 reference, 1 t27b):
24 specs from the production rehearsal of 2026-10-10 (api.t27.ai /hosting/jobs/<id> result.output, two hosts agreed),
the 18 others run on the owner Mac with the pinned t27c-darwin-arm64 and t27b-darwin-arm64 of trios-host-v0.1.0
